Amy: Hey team — large prospect (BlueRock Bank) asked for our SOC 2 report and wants a quick redacted snapshot before legal signs the NDA. Can we do a limited extract + one-time access? Customer says POC kickoff next Tue.
Jordan: We can provide a redacted SOC2 snapshot under NDA. Security needs: signed NDA pdf, an explicit reviewer list (names + emails), and a retention window (we recommend 7 days). We can include an 'interim attestation' note that confirms scope/period. ETA 48–72h after docs in.
Maria: Legal ok to accept a standard Redwood NDA. Ask sales to confirm who signs and if a countersign is needed. We also need the exact list of allowed reviewers. Watermarking + view-only PDF required. No permanent copies allowed.
Amy: I'll ask the buyer to sign our NDA by EOD. How do we generate the view-only link? Any ops steps?
Sam: Ops: we can create a short-lived viewer URL to our secure docs bucket. I can gate it behind our access service so links expire and downloads disabled. Example aws-cli presign (TTL 24h):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-secure/soc2/redacted-snapshot.pdf --expires-in 86400
```

Will also add header to tell client 'view-only' and add watermark via PDF stamp.
Jordan: Two security caveats: limit to max 3 reviewers; redact any customer-specific data from evidence; add a non-replication clause in the NDA. Also note: we will not share encryption keys or raw logs.
Maria: Confirmed. Also require requestor to provide corporate email and an IP range if possible. If customer needs more, we escalate to SOC2 bridge-letter / interim attestation docs, but that takes legal review.
Amy: Customer prefers a single PDF snapshot. They'll send reviewer names and signed NDA shortly. I'll update thread when it's in.
deploy-bot: Reminder: legal-docs queue updated — ticket #LD-4987 created for this request.
Sam: Once we have signed NDA + reviewer list I'll stage the file and post the one-time URL. I'll watermark filename with reviewer initials and TTL.
Amy: Awesome, thanks — aiming to get this done before Monday. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll prepare redaction checklist and send to Sam.
Maria: Ping me when NDA arrives, I'll countersign if needed.
Amy: Will do — closing loop.
